preamble.summary: Parameter-group swap: for the seven algorithms of the follow-ups, the values of control_2026_10_continuous_bounce with the 'coefficients' group taken from tuned_2026_10_subset_combined. Run with EXPERIMENT_CONTROL_SET.

procedure.derived_from: control_2026_10_continuous_bounce (receiver) and tuned_2026_10_subset_combined (donor): params of each block, unchanged except the swapped group
procedure.group_meaning: PSO line: every role coefficient (*_c). IKUNGA: its niching (k, crowding_weight, window, density_scale)
procedure.values_tuned_on: none: a recombination of two tuned configurations, not a tuned set

preamble.selection: params = the receiver's first final elite with the donor's group

fixed_settings.why: a setting no tuning run raced, written into every algorithm that takes it
